# MotionVfx Live 0.8.8

- Added a visible Copy / Paste section for EFX entries and attributes, with separate copy buttons and explicit source/destination labels.
- Paste entries into the selected Group or alongside a selected entry. New entries get unique names and IDs, retain their parameters, and are selected automatically.
- Paste attributes into entries or Actions, including nested PlayEmitter entries. Replacing an existing same-type attribute requires confirmation.
- Copied content is a session snapshot that survives switching files and later edits to the source. Pasting supports undo/redo and protects uncommitted input. Incompatible formats or global expression/variable tables are rejected without altering the target.
- Updated the Chinese and English tutorials with the complete copy/paste workflow. Existing parameter scrolling and window interaction optimizations are retained.

Download **MotionVfxLive-0.8.8-Setup.exe**. Exit the game normally before updating; this release updates shared Lua modules and backend 0.6.5. Existing installation upgrade and MDF-XL compatibility support are retained.

Validation: 746 local backend checks including 520 real EFX files; 27 clipboard UI checks; 168 D2D checks; real Dear ImGui parameter/input/orb regressions. CI additionally runs isolated installer, clipboard and MCP tests. This release was not tested in a live game session.

<summary>中文说明</summary>

- 在参数面板顶部加入常显的「复制 / 粘贴」区，分别提供「复制特效块」「复制此属性」，明确显示来源和粘贴目标。
- 选择目标 Group 或特效块后可「粘贴为新特效块」。自动分配不重名的名称与编号，保留参数，并自动选中新块。
- 支持向特效块、Action 及 PlayEmitter 内嵌块粘贴属性。遇到同类型属性时先确认替换，避免直接覆盖。
- 复制内容作为本次会话快照保留，切换文件或修改来源不会改变已复制内容。粘贴可撤销／重做，有未提交输入时先提示处理；格式或文件级表达式／变量表不兼容时保留目标并说明原因。
- 中英文教程补充完整操作步骤，保留此前滚动参数、拖动及缩放窗口的性能优化。

下载 **MotionVfxLive-0.8.8-Setup.exe**。更新前请正常关闭游戏；本版更新共享 Lua 模块和后台 0.6.5。保留旧版升级及 MDF-XL 兼容支持。

验证包括 746 项本地后台检查、520 份真实 EFX、27 项复制粘贴 UI 检查、168 项 D2D 检查，以及真实 Dear ImGui 参数输入与悬浮球回归。CI 另外执行隔离安装器、复制粘贴及 MCP 检查。本次未进行游戏内实测。
